title: OpenAI Python SDK client object and its request surfaces
intent: Install the OpenAI Python SDK and construct a client the current way.
notes: No network call is made and no real key is needed. The check proves the import path, the client constructor and the presence of the request surfaces.

files.check.py:
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(api_key="sk-not-a-real-key")
assert callable(client.responses.create)
assert callable(client.chat.completions.create)
assert callable(client.embeddings.create)
print("strue-ok")

avoid.why: The module-level openai.ChatCompletion API was removed in openai 1.0; use a client object.
